column7: R3: lower_pascal decides ONCE per array (a variable, a dynamic array, an array-typed field or element) from the declared element type alone: byte, shortint, char, boolean, word, smallint, longword, longint, int64, qword, an enumeration, a subrange of any of them give width 1, 2, 4 or 8 and a signedness, and the array is made by arr_make_raw(lo, hi, width, signed) in place of arr_make (a multi-dimensional array of such elements too); the ARBLK header carries ewidth (0 = DESCR elements) and esigned; every Pascal road over an element reads them: pas_arr_get and pas_arr_set_pure (movzx/movsx load into an integer DESCR, truncating store, no range check as fpc without -Cr), __pas_elem_ref, __pas_ref_val, __pas_addr, __pas_deref and __pas_deref_set (a pointer into a raw block is the existing DT_PCELL view over bytes with a raw flag: byte offset, width, signedness), the value copy of an array actual and assignment, setlength, high, low, length, sizeof, fillchar and move where they run today; no component use disqualifies a raw block; every other element type stays arr_make; the rung green at 256 MB
column8: src/lower/lower_pascal_tree.c (the decision, arr_make_raw); src/lower/lower_pascal_types.c (the element type read); src/runtime/core/array.h (ewidth, esigned); src/runtime/by_name_dispatch.c (the pas_* roads); src/runtime/builtins.tsv (arr_make_raw)

column7: R3f (officer_06 2026-11-09, on senior_08's measurement after 3e4): setlength of an array whose old block is raw (ewidth > 0, one dimension) makes the new ARBLK with no DESCR data block at all; pas_dynset in by_name_dispatch.c called pas_dyn_block(n) first, which asks rt_ws_alloc_descr for n 16-byte cells before the raw branch replaced the data pointer, so setlength(a, 20000000) of an array of boolean asked for 320,000,000 bytes (error 204 at the 131072 KB cap, 0 collections); pas_dyn_block(0) with hi set to n - 1 is the cure, the raw data block and the kept-prefix copy unchanged

R3g (officer_06 2026-11-09, on senior_08's measurement after 3e4): a dynamic array declared in a procedure or function is made by mk_array_init like a global one, so the 3e4 decision (arr_make_raw for a flat ordinal element) reaches it; mk_proc in lower_pascal_tree.c wrote arr_make(0, -1) directly for a dynamic local (the else-if arm after pas_array_high_get), never asking mk_array_init; primorial-numbers-2's sieve is such a local

R4: the three PasRosetta programs green in both modes at a declared heap under 8 GB: ALL.csv heap_kb raised to what fpc own element size needs plus the rest of the program (fusc-sequence 1,253,000,000 longwords = 5,012 MB; strong-and-weak-primes 500,000,000 + 51,000,000 bytes = 526 MB; unprimeable-numbers-2 about 1,000,000,000 booleans = 954 MB; the exact numbers re-measured by the executor), the entries through the smoke, then s4e_test_request.sh rosetta-pascal fusc-sequence strong-and-weak-primes unprimeable-numbers-2 and the fusc row closes on the coo reading

column7: R5 (CTO-492): the block header's u32 size field is renamed gran and holds the block's size in 16-byte granules (total >> 4; every block is a multiple of 16, the verify walkers refuse size & 15), so its reach is 2^32 x 16 = 64 GiB, above the 32 GB page map, and the declared heap is the ONLY cap on a block of any kind; every C reader is rewritten in place as the shift (a stale reader of size fails to compile), every asm reader of dword ptr [r + 8] shifts left by 4 after the load, every writer shifts right (a (uint32_t)total truncation is forbidden), gc_vac_t carries granules the same way; step 2's refusal of a payload over 0xFFFFFFE0 is retired (a request past the declared heap is error 204 by the ordinary road); the witness: 300,000,000 doubles (4,800,000,000 bytes of DESCRs, over 4 GiB in every representation the plan reaches) then 1.4 GB of churn forcing a collection, green in both modes at a declared 6 GB; the gc witnesses, the stress suite and the flip plant stay green
